title: What to Include in a Dubai Villa Chef Brief
body_html:
A useful villa chef brief describes the kitchen, access and cooking schedule. Separate an ongoing household routine from a holiday stay or one-off dinner so the service fits the property.

For the service options, explore private dining experiences in Dubai. Use this guide to prepare the details for your enquiry.

About this guide

This guide is published by myCHEF, a provider of private chef and catering services. It compares service formats and practical selection criteria. Individual providers should be assessed through their current proposals, relevant documentation and suitability for your occasion.

Choose ongoing support or an occasion

A household plan covers regular meals on an agreed schedule, with preferences recorded over time. A dinner party or celebration is quoted for its menu, guests and service. A holiday stay may need several dates coordinated around the guests’ plans.

Prepare a useful property brief

Share the kitchen equipment, dining area, access arrangements and any outdoor facilities. Confirm gate passes and parking before arrival. Grills and garden service depend on the property’s permissions and a suitable plan for the weather.

Review the match and the costs

Ask how the chef is assessed, how the proposed profile is approved and what happens if cover is needed. Household pricing follows visits and schedule, while event pricing follows the occasion. Groceries, service staff, hire and VAT should be clearly identified.

Questions to ask before confirming

Request a written menu and scope, confirm the guest count and service hours, and check which staff, equipment and extras are included. Share dietary requirements before approving the menu. Review the payment schedule, change deadlines and cancellation terms, and identify the contact who will coordinate the booking.

Use your completed brief

If villa chef services suits your plans, explore the service details and published options below. Share your date, Dubai location, guest count and preferences so the team can assess availability and prepare a tailored proposal. The written booking confirms the final menu, responsibilities and price.
